"recent": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "deprecated": "Deprecated. Use <var>queryInfo.lastUsed</var> and <var>queryInfo.sort</var>.",
                "optional": true,
                "description": "Whether the folder (excluding subfolders) has been used within the last month, or not. The returned folders will be sorted by <var>lastUsed</var>."
              },
              "sort": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": ["lastUsed", "lastUsedAsDestination", "name", "path"],
                "optional": true,
                "default": "path",
                "description": "The sort order of the returned folders. If not specified, folders will be sorted by <var>path</var>. Sorting by <var>name</var> is case-insensitive."
